verdicts.quote: “The V2 API requires an access token… There are two options… A Personal Access Token… [or] Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow…”
verdicts.reason: Docs clearly support OAuth2 for third‑party integrations; PATs also exist, but OAuth2 is the appropriate primary method for multi‑tenant apps.

verdicts.quote: “Your Harvest subscription includes API access for all accounts (including free and trial accounts)…”
verdicts.reason: Confirms credentials are available self‑serve on free/trial. OAuth apps/PATs are created in the Harvest ID “Developers” section, with no stated app review.

verdicts.quote: “Set the Remote MCP server URL to: https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp”

verdicts.quote: “The application can be created from the Developers section of Harvest ID…”
verdicts.reason: Self‑serve OAuth app/PAT, comprehensive docs, and no partner/sales gating suggest it’s buildable now; only normal rate limits apply.
